summary_en: 2,566,578 shares (10.13% of voting rights) acquired 2026-05-25 by TO System Limited (代表取締役社長 林雅也) from three current directors: 林勝 (Chairman), 林宗治 (President), 林雅也 (Deputy President). TO System stated intent to hold as stable shareholder long-term. Acquisition exempted from advance public-offer disclosure under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Art. 7.
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Acquisition by TO System Limited in SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS CORP. (Code 3371) as an Act Equivalent to Public Tender Offer
translation_en_brief: On 2026-05-25, TO System Limited (代表取締役社長 林雅也) acquired 2,566,578 shares of SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS CORP. from three current company directors acting as shareholders: 林勝 (Chairman), 林宗治 (President), and 林雅也 (Deputy President). The acquisition represents 10.13% of total voting rights as of 2026-03-31 (253,325 voting units outstanding). TO System stated its intent to hold the shares long-term as a stable shareholder. Although the acquisition crosses the 5% voting-rights threshold, it qualifies for exemption from advance notice requirements under Financial Instruments and Exchange Act Ordinance Article 7 (exemptions from public-offer rules). This disclosure is being made by TO System at the request of the target company pursuant to FIEA Ordinance Article 30(1)(4). The transaction represents a concentration of shareholding among the company's founding family; no acquisition price is disclosed in the filing.
